lines: The home of Ukrainian debate clubs: find a club, register for a session, debate — and follow standings and your own results in one place.
Registering for a session needs no account — the club shares one link. Sign in to keep your history, schedule and personal stats.

blocks.text: Read from cab's own records only (club rows, member counts, each club's current session) — no engine call. Next session in words: date — register while sign-ups are open, starting soon once closed, live now — watch rooms while running.
